title: Ning Li last seen at MITRE anti-gravity conference

tellings.quote: But she was seen last publicly speaking at this MITER uh corporation conference about anti-gravity.
The last time Ning Lee really spoke in a public way on record about her anti-gravity work was at a MITER conference.
tellings.link_reason: The same last public talk by Ning Li, at a MITRE anti-gravity conference near DC in 2003.

as_told.title: Ning Li's last public talk at MITRE conference

plain: A researcher named Ning Li, who worked on anti-gravity, is said to have made her last public, on-record appearance in 2003 at a conference about anti-gravity held by MITRE, a research company near Washington that does work for the US government. Michels says this himself on two separate episodes, without naming a source. He brings it up because, in his telling, she went quiet after that, which would suggest her work was taken out of public view.
